decisive_items: 10-cm mass of the organ of Zuckerkandl
response.rationale: C1 precisely identifies the hereditary SDHB-related paraganglioma, which explains the multifocal presentation (organ of Zuckerkandl mass, adrenal bed recurrence, prostate metastasis) and biochemical profile. R4 is a generic paraganglioma diagnosis lacking the syndromic specificity. R1 incorrectly localizes the primary to the prostate, which is more consistent with metastasis given the prior organ of Zuckerkandl mass and SDHB mutation.

rejected.why: The prostate lesion is a secondary deposit, not the primary; the diagnosis is SDHB-related paraganglioma, not prostatic paraganglioma.
